sections.label: 2020 total employment contraction
sections.summary: In 2020, total employment contracted by 166,600, the sharpest contraction in two decades.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: In 2020, total employment contracted by 166,600 and this is the sharpest contraction in two decades.

sections.label: Foreign workers, job vacancies, local placements
sections.summary: In the first half of 2021 foreign workers declined by 32,600, job vacancies hit 92,100, and 140,000 locals were placed in jobs and skills opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: In the first half of 2021, the total number of foreign workers continued to decline by another 32,600.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The number of seasonally adjusted job vacancies in the overall economy rose to an all-time high of 92,100 in June 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The seasonally adjusted job vacancy to unemployed person ratio increased to 1.63 in June 2021, exceeding one for the first time since March 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Through the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package, we have placed 140,000 locals into jobs and skills opportunities between April 2020 and end August 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The Jobs Growth Incentive (JGI) was introduced in September 2020 and has supported 58,000 businesses to hire more than 400,000 locals thus far.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Overall, the number of employed residents has risen by 43,500 since the start of 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: For example, the Singapore Business Federation (SBF) is helping to match employers with hiring needs to experienced foreign workers already in Singapore but who are no longer needed by their current employers.
